'''Heerimus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] representative who served [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Doli-bur Barc]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Heerimus was a young man serving in [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Doli-bur Barc]]'s administration in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] around [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Heerimus represented the interests of Senator Barc when interacting with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and other groups on Coruscant. When a shipment destined for Barc's offices was hijacked, Heerimus sought out an individual who could bolster the search for the missing data chips.<ref name="SWTORTSSG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Heerimus appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Coruscant quest called "The Senator's Stolen Goods".
